data.content_ref: inline:0e26d6be54fd abstracts SRC_009, SRC_010, and SRC_011: the problem generalizes from three specific failed neighbourhood connection attempts — self-referential integration (SRC_009), mischaracterized reduction grounded in wrong source content (SRC_010), and mischaracterized contradiction from misreading the problem's own framing (SRC_011) — into a meta-requirement that all future connections be substantive, correctly grounded, and carry refutation conditions. The problem is the covering principle extracted from those failures. REFUTED IF the problem's formulation is independent of those specific prior failures (i.e., it would have the same form without them), or if it prescribes a connection protocol that fails to address the failure modes SRC_009, SRC_010, and SRC_011 identify (self-reference, source mischaracterization, framing mischaracterization).
